name: EPIC 212394760
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 8.8 solar radii and 0.83 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,434 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.83 solar masses and 8.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,813 K at its surface.
